changelog:
- New: MCP server (Settings > MCP, off by default). Lets an AI agent such as Claude Code list, open, close and read panes, run commands, and brainstorm on the scratchpad. Local only, behind a token.
- New: Start in folder (Settings > Shell): where SplitView opens its first pane. Type it or pick it with Browse.
- Fixed: wide characters (CJK) read back with extra spaces.
- Removed: remote control (phone pairing).
